title: Verbose action summary and rollback-friendly patch format for admin audit events
creator: Asha Raman
description:
Summary:
This ticket defines a new audit event shape and taxonomy for admin and RBAC-related actions that balances machine-parsable minimal patches with a single-line human_summary for quick operator triage. The goal is to produce rollback-friendly, integrity-signed events that work across Hosted/Dedicated/Private deployments and across SSO/SAML identity link operations.

Motivation:
- Current audit payloads focus on fully compact diffs (byte-efficient) or full snapshots. Both extremes complicate quick incident triage or fast rollback: compact diffs are hard to human-interpret without enrichment; full snapshots are expensive for retention and leak PII.
- Need consistent actor/target taxonomy for RBAC v2 (roles, grants, policies, sessions, connectors) and explicit SSO/SAML linkage events.

Goals:
- Define canonical event schema (schema_version = rbac.v2.audit.1).
- Provide a minimal, ordered patch format that is rollback-friendly and human-readable when necessary.
- Include a concise human_summary string and structured patch list for tooling.
- Enforce PII redaction rules, signing, and retention tiers.

Non-goals:
- Not implementing storage/ingestion pipeline changes (separate infra ticket).
- Not replacing existing long-term forensic snapshots for incident postmortems; we aim to optimize regular operational audit traffic.

Proposed event shape (flat fields intended for the platform event envelope):
- schema_version: rbac.v2.audit.1
- event_id: <uuid>
- timestamp: <iso8601>
- request_id: <uuid or trace span id>
- actor_kind: one of [user, service, system, external_idp, scheduled_job]
- actor_id: canonical principal id (user:U12345, svc:S-...)
- actor_identity_source: e.g., internal-directory, saml:idp:acme, oidc:github
- actor_display_name: localized display name (redacted if PII)
- target_kind: one of [role, grant, policy, resource, session, api_key, connector]
- target_id: canonical id or path (role:role-123, policy:policy-55)
- action_verb: short verb token (e.g., CREATE_ROLE, UPDATE_ROLE_PERMS, ASSIGN_ROLE, REVOKE_ROLE, SSO_LINK, SSO_UNLINK, ELEVATE_SESSION, DEPRECATE_POLICY)
- outcome: success | partial_failure | failure
- outcome_reason: free-form (short) string for operator clarity
- human_summary: single-line English summary suitable for chatops/alerts (eg "Alice assigned infra-admin role to svc:ingest-1 (success)")
- structured_patch: list of compact patch op strings (see encoding below)
- pre_snapshot_hint: optional short serialized blob fingerprint or small JSON string (<= 1024 bytes) when full pre-snapshot is needed for complex ops
- sampling_tier: realtime | standard | sparse (for retention rules)
- redaction_tags: list of fields that were redacted (e.g., ["actor_display_name"])
- signature: base64(signature) covering event envelope except this field

Patch encoding (human-first compact ops):
- Each op is a single string using colon-delimited tokens to avoid nested objects in the core store. Format: "<op>:<path>:<detail>". Examples: 
  - "add:/roles/role-123/permissions:read,write"
  - "remove:/roles/role-123/permissions:legacy-admin"
  - "replace:/roles/role-123/description:'Old text'->'New text'"
  - "link-sso:/users/U123:provider=acme;external_id=abc-123"
- For multi-field updates we prefer a sequence of ops rather than a single blob; order is significant and should be applied top-to-bottom for rollback semantics.
- Old and new values are included for replace ops to support automated rollback: the arrow notation 'old'->'new' is canonical in human_summary and patch strings.
- Op strings are intentionally textual to be searchable in logs and simple to parse with lightweight regex or split-based parsers.

Actor / Target taxonomy notes:
- Actors may be "external_idp" for SSO-initiated events. In that case an actor_id of the form "idp:acme:external-456" is allowed and actor_identity_source clarifies mapping.
- Targets for RBAC v2 should be path-like canonical ids: role:<id>, grant:<id>, policy:<id>, resource:/org/123/project/456.
- When a change touches multiple targets (e.g., role assignment that also creates a grant), emit a single event with multiple structured_patch entries and a primary target in target_id; secondary targets listed in an additional_targets CSV string in the envelope.

Redaction & PII handling:
- No raw email, SSN, or external tokens in top-level fields — replace with masked tokens and add redaction_tags.
- SSO/SAML assertions included only as references (assertion_id) not raw assertion bodies. If a SAML assertion must be captured for forensic reasons, it should be stored in a separate, access-controlled blob store and referenced by artifact_id in the event.

Retention and sampling tiers:
- realtime: high-fidelity events stored 90 days hot, 365 days cold; minimal sampling, used for control-plane admin ops.
- standard: default retention 365 days with light sampling for high-volume service-initiated ops.
- sparse: sample 1% by default for noisy, low-signal operations (e.g., ephemeral connector heartbeats).

Integrity and signing:
- All events must include signature (envelope-level) and schema_version. Signature keys rotate via KMS; events include signature_key_id.

Migration and rollout plan:
1) Landing PR: schema docs + serialization lib + unit tests (beta flag).
2) Integrate with Admin Console change flows (canary to 10% tenants).
3) Add SSO connector hooks to emit new formatted link/unlink events.
4) Backfill: option to emit compatibility shadow events mapping new fields to older consumers for 60 days.

Acceptance criteria and verification are below in acceptance_criteria.

Sample compact event (human-readable rendering, not nested JSON in this ticket):
- schema_version=r bac.v2.audit.1; event_id=uuid; timestamp=2025-02-15T13:10:22Z; actor_kind=user; actor_id=U-271; actor_identity_source=internal-directory; target_kind=role; target_id=role-ops-99; action_verb=UPDATE_ROLE_PERMS; outcome=success; human_summary="Diego updated role role-ops-99: removed legacy-admin, added read:logs"; structured_patch=["remove:/roles/role-ops-99/permissions:legacy-admin","add:/roles/role-ops-99/permissions:read,logs","replace:/roles/role-ops-99/description:'Ops role'->'Ops role (tightened perms)'"]; signature=...
acceptance_criteria: New events adhere to schema_version 'rbac.v2.audit.1' and include envelope-level signature and signature_key_id.
Every admin API surface emits human_summary and structured_patch for relevant ops.
Replace ops include both old and new values to enable automated rollback tooling.
Redaction tags are set when PII is removed and a documented artifact reference is present if full data is archived.
Audit events respect sampling_tier and are routed to appropriate retention storage.
End-to-end integration tests validate signature verification, parsing of patch ops, and human_summary generation.
